overLimit.context: Accessible label of the warning icon on a category tile.

over.context: Category tile: small word after the amount over the limit, e.g. '−120 zł over'. Very short.

left.context: Category tile: small word after the amount still available, e.g. '380 zł left'. Very short.

spentOf.context: Category tile: tiny line, e.g. 'spent 620 of 1,000 · 62%'. Must be very short: the tile is a third of a phone's width.

noLimit.context: Category tile: tiny line under the amount spent for a category without a limit.

page.context: Accessible label of one page of category tiles (swiped sideways).

pageDot.context: Accessible label of a page dot under the category tiles.
